summary: Iteration 19 - Frontend UI Testing for Super Admin Tenant Admin Management. All 10 features tested successfully. The UI properly implements create, view, edit, change password, and delete operations for tenant_admin users.

ui_bugs.issue: Minor React warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - appears in console but doesn't affect functionality

issues: Form inputs for Email and Nombre completo are visually similar - could benefit from better labeling or placeholder text to distinguish them

passed_tests: Access Super Admin tab as admin user
View list of existing tenant_admin users with stats (organizations, groups, devices)
Open create dialog for new tenant admin
Create new tenant_admin user (test_tenant/test@test.com/Test123!) - shows success toast
Stats card updates correctly after user creation (1→2 Tenant Admins)
View user details dialog shows email, name, created date, status, device stats, and assigned organizations
Edit user dialog opens and shows form with email, full name, active status, and organization checkboxes
Change password dialog opens and password update works correctly
Login with new tenant_admin credentials (test_tenant/NewPass123!) - user sees limited dashboard
Delete tenant_admin user - confirmation dialog and success message
Stats update after deletion (2→1 Tenant Admins)
critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes are correctly implemented: create-tenant-admin-btn, new-tenant-username, new-tenant-email, new-tenant-password, confirm-create-tenant, confirm-delete-tenant, tenant-admin-row-{username}
Form validation works correctly - fields are required before submission
Error handling with toast notifications is properly implemented
Multi-tenancy filtering works correctly - tenant_admin user doesn't see Super Admin tab
Console shows accessibility warning for DialogContent missing Description - minor issue
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test_tenant user during testing for cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Super Admin UI for tenant admin management is fully functional. Key features: (1) Create tenant_admin with username, email, password, full_name, organization assignments (2) View details showing device stats and assigned organizations (3) Edit user info and organization assignments (4) Change password (5) Delete user. Data-testid selectors are properly implemented for all main UI actions.
